title: What is the percentage difference in total favorite counts between posts by
question: What is the percentage difference in total favorite counts between posts by the oldest users and posts by users who earned a 'Student' badge in 2010?

prediction.sql:
WITH oldest_user AS (
    SELECT XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users
    WHERE XCL_054 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY XCL_054 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
student_badge_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_002 AS user_id
    FROM badges
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'Student'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', XCL_004) = '2010'
),
oldest_favorites AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(XCL_039), 0) AS total_favorites
    FROM posts
    WHERE XCL_033 = (SELECT user_id FROM oldest_user)
),
student_favorites AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_039), 0) AS total_favorites
    FROM posts p
    JOIN student_badge_users sbu ON p.XCL_033 = sbu.user_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM oldest_favorites) - 
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
        ) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
    END AS percentage_difference

    FROM users

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM oldest_favorites) - 
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
        ) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
    END AS percentage_difference

Percentage difference: Correctly computed as relative difference with student badge users' total as the denominator.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  (CAST(
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN v.XCL_068 = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     FROM posts p JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
     WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT XCL_052 FROM users ORDER BY XCL_054 ASC LIMIT 1)) AS REAL)
   -
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN v.XCL_068 = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     FROM posts p JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
     WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Student' AND STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010'))
  ) /
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN v.XCL_068 = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   FROM posts p JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
   WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Student' AND STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010')) * 100

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH oldest_user AS (
    SELECT XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY XCL_054 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
student_badge_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_002 AS user_id
    FROM badges
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'Student'
      AND XCL_004 >= '2010-01-01'
      AND XCL_004 < '2011-01-01'
),
oldest_favorites AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(XCL_037), 0) AS total_favorites
    FROM posts
    WHERE XCL_033 = (SELECT user_id FROM oldest_user)
),
student_favorites AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_037), 0) AS total_favorites
    FROM posts p
    JOIN student_badge_users sbu ON p.XCL_033 = sbu.user_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM oldest_favorites) - 
            (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
        ) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_favorites FROM student_favorites)
    END AS percentage_difference
